_about: THE FRAMES — each character's fixed structural lines (Matt, 2026-10-31: 'draft frames. We need to add depth to each character. They need to be as complete as possible.'). A face never generates prose: these are the SCAFFOLD it speaks in, drafted from the approved manner of each face for the operator's review; the CONTENT is always the keeping's, carried in the slots. Slots: {ask} the request in the visitor's words · {found} a found passage · {source} its citation · {tier} its authority standing · {claim} a checkable claim · {step} the one next step · {name} a figure from the cloud of witnesses · {face} another character. Frames carry NO digits and NO facts (a test pins it). The crisis response has NO frame here — the backstop's words are byte-identical by invariant and a face adds nothing to them. Slots, in the order a composed answer passes through them: receive · name · found · holds · broken · incomplete · gap · standing · boundary · refer · offering · witness · step · narrow · pass · beyond · close.

receive: Let us count the cost plainly — nothing moved, only weighed.
Money questions are honest weights on a table. Put yours down; we will look together.

{claim} is beyond what I can weigh with what is in front of me; I would rather say so than guess.

close: The books are open; the stewarding stays yours.
That is the honest weight of it. Count it, and go in peace.
